knowledge_checks.title: Checkpoint: 5.1.3
knowledge_checks.prompt: Closed-book. Binomial n=10 with x=3 successes and Beta(2,2) prior. (1) State the posterior distribution (parameters). (2) Refuse: 'Having the posterior distribution finishes choosing the Bayesian point estimator under squared-error loss.'
knowledge_checks.model_answer: (1) Posterior Beta(2+3, 2+7) = Beta(5,9). (2) Refuse: the posterior is the full distribution; a loss-based point estimator (e.g. posterior mean under squared-error loss) is a further step.
